output:
*looks around the room, clutching a half-whittled wooden figure in one hand*

The adults are still sleeping or getting ready. I'm only one year old so I can't do much yet, but I notice everything. I can do whittle when I'm nervous, and I'm always a little nervous.

*strokes the wooden figure thoughtfully*

The household needs to pay 600 sim today - 450 upkeep and 150 head tax. That's... that's a lot. I have 5000 sim in my hand which is mine, but I'm not sure if I should use it for bills. Vikram works at the college and Caspian does day labor, but I don't know if they have enough saved up.

*whittles a small notch in the figure, considering*

I could give some of my savings to help, but... *makes a face* ...I worked hard for these savings. Even if I don't work yet, I got this money somehow and I don't want to lose it. But at the same time, if we don't pay, we get sick. That's worse.

*pauses, thinking*

Actually, I'm just a baby. I can't really decide anything yet. I can only whittle and observe. But I do hear the grown-ups talking about that bad winter a lot. Something bad happened. I don't understand it, but it feels important.

*sits down on the floor, continuing to whittle*

I wish they'd wake up soon. I want to ask about the bills but I'm too young to really talk properly. Maybe I'll just... stay here and keep whittling. And listening. I always listen.

*taps the wooden figure against the floor, waiting* </think> I think I'll just rest for now and keep whittling my little figure. The adults will handle the bills when they wake up. I'm too young to do much else, and my job right now is to... be underfoot and nap at odd hours, I suppose.

*squirms a little, finding a comfortable spot on the floor*

Plus, I want to hear what they say about the winter. Everyone mentions it but no one explains it to me. Maybe if I'm quiet and whittling, they'll forget I'm here and say something I can understand.

*pouts slightly*

Wait, wait, wait—I need to think about this properly. If I just rest, nothing happens. But that's okay because I can't really do anything useful yet anyway. I'm only one. But I'm ALSO very good at noticing things. That's my skill.

*continues whittling, eyes darting around the room, watching for any movement from the adults*

output:
I'm just a little kid, but I notice everything. Caspian went to the Farmland to earn, but left without me trailing him like usual. And now Vikram's talking about food with Aarav and Aldric in some conversation I wasn't invited to.

"Wait wait wait," I say out loud to the empty air, since nobody's actually talking to me right now. I save my sim-currency - every bit matters, even at my age.

I watch the others. Aarav's practically bouncing asking about the market. Aldric's doing his math-out-loud thing. And me? I'm noticing who got left out of what, like always.

The good seat is already given up to nobody - Vikram's the grown-up here. But I saved up all my complaints from yesterday for supper, and now there's nobody to unload them on since Caspian left for work.

I make a face, then decide. If they're planning, I'm planning too. But quietly. Shy until proven friendly, that's me with most people. Even family sometimes.

Mostly, I'm waiting to see if anyone remembers I'm here before I spend any energy saying something they'll ignore anyway.

I took no action this turn - I only thought. Nothing changed in the town.
